text: We are all mortal until the first kiss and the second glass of wine.
author: Eduardo Galeano

archive.text: Being in humaneness is good. If we select other goodness and thus are far apart from humaneness, how can we be the wise?
archive.author: Confucius

archive.text: To follow, without halt, one aim: There is the secret of success.
archive.author: Anna Pavlova

archive.text: One does not become enlightened by imagining figures of light, but by making the darkness conscious.
archive.author: Carl Jung

archive.text: Peace at home, peace in the world.
archive.author: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk

archive.text: From error to error one discovers the entire truth.
archive.author: Sigmund Freud

archive.text: Believe deep down in your heart that you're destined to do great things.
archive.author: Joe Paterno

archive.text: I have learned over the years that when one's mind is made up, this diminishes fear; knowing what must be done does away with fear.
archive.author: Rosa Parks
